mesh_path.description: Path to mesh file (GLB, OBJ, STL, etc.) - will be automatically converted to point cloud

npz_path.description: Path to NPZ file containing 'points' and 'normals' arrays

points.description: Point cloud coordinates as array of shape (N, 3)

normals.description: Point cloud normals as array of shape (N, 3) - optional

num_points.description: Number of points to sample from mesh (only used with mesh_path)

max_new_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (increase for complex objects)

do_sample.description: Whether to use sampling or greedy decoding

zero_out_normals.description: Whether to ignore normals and use zeros (recommended)

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible point cloud downsampling
